diagnosis: The Prisma extension protects legalDocument.delete, but fails to implement an interceptor for deleteMany. The route handler uses deleteMany({ where: { id: req.params.docId } }), completely bypassing the extension's organizationId filter. Any authenticated organization member can permanently delete enterprise contracts and legal documents belonging to other organizations.
